temporal__pre_median_weekly_commits.description: Median of four complete pre-peak UTC weeks of root/one-parent commits reachable from the frozen head; null if any baseline week is ineligible.

temporal__post_median_weekly_commits_8w.description: Median of eight complete follow-up UTC weekly non-merge counts; null if the full follow-up is unobserved.

temporal__post_pre_commit_ratio.description: Eight-week post median / four-week pre median; requires both complete windows and positive pre median. Not a trust score.

temporal__post_active_week_share_8w.description: Number of complete follow-up weeks with positive non-merge counts divided by eight; null unless all eight weeks are observed.

temporal__peak_week_nonmerge_commits.description: Unique root/one-parent commits reachable from frozen head with UTC committer timestamp in the nominal peak week [start,end).

temporal__issue_opened_pre_4w_count.description: Current GitHub search-index issue creations excluding PRs; count within explicit start-inclusive/end-exclusive UTC window; ineligible or incomplete source coverage remains null.

temporal__issue_opened_pre_4w_per_week.description: Current GitHub search-index issue creations excluding PRs; divided by nominal window weeks only for a full eligible period.

temporal__pr_opened_pre_4w_count.description: Current GitHub search-index PR creations, not merges; count within explicit start-inclusive/end-exclusive UTC window; ineligible or incomplete source coverage remains null.

temporal__pr_opened_pre_4w_per_week.description: Current GitHub search-index PR creations, not merges; divided by nominal window weeks only for a full eligible period.
